requirement.value: Cook (Gourmet), Archivist (Loremaster) or Engineer (Tinkerer) mastery (the Merchant route is cut)

system.description: Potions and delicacies you create, and spells you cast, may take a creature's HP and MP above their maximums, to a ceiling of 150% of each score. At the end of each scene anything still above maximum drops back to maximum.
